quote: Net-30 on paper. Net-120 in practice. Every single invoice.
Signed off the job, then 'disputed' it the day payment was due.
Owed three of us. Closed the company. Reopened down the road as a new UEN.
The letter of demand arrived the week the invoice came due. Funny, that.
Took the 50% deposit, ghosted on delivery, blocked my number.
Quoted low to win the tender, then 'unforeseen costs' doubled it.
Paid me when his client paid him. That wasn't our contract.
Hired my designer the week after she pitched them. Same deck.
Three strike-offs in five years and he's still tendering for jobs.
Two suppliers already flagged him. He's opening an account with a third.
